## 2026-07-22 02:24 UTC -- Fixed PR #80 CI: hooks remove test fragile against git template samples (sweep)

Approved gate: investigate + fix red CI on PR #80 (feat/issue-14-hooks-helper).

Diagnosis: `hooks_remove_deletes_the_file` (tests/workflow.rs) failed on ubuntu/macos/windows/MSRV — the panic at line 903 was the "removed hook is gone" assertion, not the remove() call. Clean `git init` seeds pre-push.sample; after removing the installed real pre-push hook, the sample survives and src/hooks.rs::classify_hooks reports it under the bare name "pre-push", so list() still contains "pre-push". Passed locally only because this box's git template seeds real hooks (commit-msg, pre-commit) instead of stock samples. Reproduced the failure locally by seeding a pre-push.sample in a controlled core.hooksPath dir.

Fix (commit 6f81a44, pushed to same branch, no new PR): point the remove test at a controlled initially-empty core.hooksPath dir, the same pattern hooks_list_strips_sample_suffix_and_marks_disabled already uses. src/hooks.rs left unchanged — the library behavior (reporting a sample under its bare name) is correct; only the test's absence assumption was fragile. Added 13 lines to the test.

Local verification all green: cargo fmt --check, clippy --all-targets --all-features -D warnings, cargo test --all-features (full suite incl all 5 hooks tests), and the CI-only rustdoc gate RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps --all-features.

Outcome pending: GitHub had not queued a CI run for 6f81a44 ~6 min after push (only the old c9bac3e runs showed). Recorded in memory [[issue-14-status]] and new lesson [[hooks-tests-need-controlled-hookspath]]. Next sweep: verify PR #80 CI green, then if green+comment-free propose repo_ready_pr.

Confirmed #44 is a real bug: command.rs execute_internal uses `cmd.output().await` inside `tokio::time::timeout`; on expiry the future is dropped and tokio's Child does not kill on drop, so the git child + any grandchildren leak (can hold index.lock). BUT #44 needs a new dep (libc/nix for killpg), a Windows Job Object path, and an inherently flaky orphan-detection test on a strict multi-platform CI. Deferred again as a dedicated future sweep, not this one.

Chose #41 (changes helper) as this sweep's single item: composes existing status/diff builders + the status parser that now returns branch/ahead/behind metadata (landed in fdc2f30) and parse_diff_name_status — no new deps, no new command builders, proven 5th-time helper pattern, trivial additive lib.rs/repo.rs contention. ## 2026-07-21 18:21 UTC -- Sweep 2026-07-21c: PR #67 conflict cleared; deeper CI root cause found (bisect parses stdout-only, git writes to stderr) (sweep)

Approved item executed on PR #67: merged origin/main to clear CONFLICTING (2247115, resolved src/parse.rs), + fixed 2 merged-in sync configure_identity calls to .await in tests/porcelain.rs (68e31da). Pushed to same branch; PR now MERGEABLE, still draft. All local gates green (fmt, clippy --all-features, test --all-features incl 21 workflow + bisect tests, rustdoc -D warnings).

However CI is STILL RED. The approved diagnosis (SIGCHLD reaper flake, fix via executor conversion) was WRONG: the bisect test's async-executor conversion was already present, and Windows (no SIGCHLD) fails too. Fresh run 29856177200 on 68e31da: bisect_converges_on_first_bad_commit fails deterministically on macOS+Windows (both toolchains), ubuntu passes. Real root cause: BisectCommand::parse_result reads output.stdout_str() only, but modern git writes bisect progress to STDERR; ubuntu's older git uses stdout -> platform split, never reaches Found -> non-convergence after 10 loops.

Correct fix (a real feature change, beyond approved scope; #53 is agent:blocked): parse_bisect should classify from combined stdout+stderr. Re-surfacing via request_permission rather than silently pivoting. Diagnosis saved to memory issue-53-status.

Added src/stashes.rs: Repository::stashes() -> StashOps<'_>, workflow-gated. StashEntry { index, branch, subject, sha } parsed from `git stash list -z --format=%gd%x1f%H%x1f%gs` (NUL records, unit-separated fields). list/push/pop/apply/drop/clear delegate to the existing StashCommand. ## 2026-07-21 16:39 UTC -- Sweep 2026-07-21: defer #44, propose #11 (sweep)

Backlog unchanged (18 open). Inbox empty. PRs: #67 draft (=#53 bisect, agent-claimed), #59 release.

Re-examined #44 (kill process group on timeout). Bug is real: `execute_internal` uses `cmd.output().await`; on `tokio::time::timeout` expiry the future is dropped and git's grandchildren (pack/askpass/hooks) orphan. BUT the fix is medium+, not small: needs a new dep (`libc` for `killpg`; crate currently has only 5 lean runtime deps), cross-platform cfg gating (Unix `process_group(0)` + Windows Job Object fallback), AND an inherently race-prone orphan-detection test that collides with the known macOS SIGCHLD reaper flake. Also labeled `enhancement`, not `bug`. Deferring #44 as a dep/design decision better suited to a human-scoped PR, not an unattended small sweep.

Proposing #11 instead: typed stashes workflow helper. Purely additive, sits on the existing `StashCommand` (push/pop/apply/drop/list/show/clear all present), parses `git stash list`, `workflow`-gated, no new deps, no flaky tests. Follows the `WorkflowOps` pattern in src/workflow.rs. Cleanest small well-scoped item.
